multiSelect.refusal.clip.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): why clips cannot join a selection of several items.

multiSelect.refusal.click.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): why recorded clicks cannot join a selection; {command} is the title of the command that finds stray clicks.

multiSelect.refusal.caption.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): why captions cannot join a selection.

multiSelect.refusal.layout.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): why camera layouts cannot join a selection.

multiSelect.why.start.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): what stops a selection being moved, after "The selection stops here:" and the like.

multiSelect.why.end.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): what stops a selection being moved, after "The selection stops here:" and the like.

multiSelect.why.zoom.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): what stops a selection being moved, after "The selection stops here:" and the like.

multiSelect.why.freezeClip.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): what stops a selection being moved, after "The selection stops here:" and the like.

multiSelect.why.freezeTaken.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): what stops a selection being moved, after "The selection stops here:" and the like.

multiSelect.freezeInCut.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): a freeze frame in a cut keeps the selection from moving. Ctrl is a keycap.

multiSelect.full.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): the selection cannot move because it spans the whole recording.

multiSelect.stopsHere.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): a dragged selection is held back; {why} is the reason (editor.multiSelect.why.*).

multiSelect.lessThan.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): a move too short to show in hundredths of a second; {s} is 0.01. s is the unit for seconds and stays Latin.

multiSelect.notMoved.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): a selection could not move at all; {why} is the reason (editor.multiSelect.why.*).

multiSelect.movedLater.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): a selection moved less far than asked; {s} is how far ("0.6 s"), {why} the reason.

multiSelect.movedEarlier.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): a selection moved less far than asked; {s} is how far ("0.6 s"), {why} the reason.

multiSelect.selectNone.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): Select all found nothing to select.

multiSelect.selectEvery.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): Select all, the second time: every item of every track; {n} is how many.

multiSelect.selectOnly.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): Select all found one item on its track; {what} is its kind ("zoom").

multiSelect.selectOnlyAgain.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): Select all found one item on its track; {what} is its kind ("zoom"), {keys} the Select all shortcut.

multiSelect.selectAll.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): Select all selected the items on a track; {what} is how many of what ("12 text items").

multiSelect.selectAllAgain.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): Select all selected the items on a track; {what} is how many of what ("12 text items"), {keys} the Select all shortcut.

multiSelect.shapesTrack.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): what Select all selected when the shapes track holds shapes and spotlights; {n} is how many (always two or more).

multiSelect.deleted.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): the selected items were deleted; {n} is how many. The Undo shortcut may follow.

multiSelect.cut.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): the selected items were cut to the clipboard; {n} is how many. The Undo shortcut may follow.

multiSelect.copyLookFirst.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): Paste look has no look to paste; {keys} is the Copy look shortcut.

multiSelect.copyLookFirstButton.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): Paste look has no look to paste, and Copy look has no shortcut.

multiSelect.nothingCopied.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): Paste found nothing copied; {keys} is the Copy shortcut.

multiSelect.nothingCopiedPalette.description: Notice after selecting several timeline items (multi-select): Paste found nothing copied, and Copy has no shortcut; {command} is the Copy command's title.

notice.noRoomForZoom.description: Notice: dragging the picture or adding a zoom found no free time for a new zoom at the playhead.

preview.groupOutline.description: Preview: tooltip of the outline around an item in a selection of several. Ctrl is a keycap.

preview.groupHint.description: Preview: hint while several items are selected; {n} is how many of them are on the picture now. Ctrl is a keycap.

preview.focusHint.description: Preview: hint while choosing where a zoom looks; a Done button follows.

preview.regionBox.description: Preview: tooltip of the box a region zoom frames. Shift is a keycap.

preview.regionHint.description: Preview: hint while drawing a region zoom; a Done button follows. Shift is a keycap.

preview.moveText.description: Preview: tooltip of the handle on the selected text.

preview.moveEnd.description: Preview: tooltip of an end of a selected line or arrow.

preview.moveArrowhead.description: Preview: tooltip of the head of a selected arrow.

preview.followsResize.description: Preview: tooltip of a spotlight that follows the cursor.

preview.shapeBox.description: Preview: tooltip of the box of a selected shape or spotlight. Shift is a keycap.

preview.follows.description: Preview: tag on a spotlight that follows the cursor.

preview.cursorSpotlight.description: Preview: the name of a spotlight that follows the cursor, in the hint under a selected one.

preview.spotlight.description: Preview: the name of a spotlight on an area, in the hint under a selected one.

preview.cursorOff.description: Preview: in the hint under a selected cursor spotlight, after its name and " · ": nothing to show at the playhead.

preview.dragToPlace.description: Preview: in the hint under a selected cursor spotlight, after its name and " · ".

preview.dragToPlaceOrDraw.description: Preview: in the hint under a selected shape or spotlight, after its name and " · ".

tab.style.description: Inspector: the name of a settings tab, on its button and as its tooltip.

tab.cursor.description: Inspector: the name of a settings tab, on its button and as its tooltip.

tab.clip.description: Inspector: the name of a settings tab, on its button and as its tooltip.

tab.graphics.description: Inspector: the name of a settings tab, on its button and as its tooltip.

tab.transcript.description: Inspector: the name of a settings tab, on its button and as its tooltip.

tab.shapes.description: Inspector: the name of a settings tab, on its button and as its tooltip.

tab.images.description: Inspector: the name of a settings tab, on its button and as its tooltip.

tab.effects.description: Inspector: the name of a settings tab, on its button and as its tooltip.

tab.audio.description: Inspector: the name of a settings tab, on its button and as its tooltip.

inspector.description: Inspector: accessible name of the rail of settings tabs.

tab.selectionTitle.description: Inspector: tooltip of the Selection tab, shown while two or more items are selected; {n} is how many.

tab.selection.description: Inspector: the tab of the items selected together.

save.notSaved.description: Title bar: the last save failed; the reason follows.

save.retry.description: Title bar: button that saves again after a save failed.
